description: Buddy provides infrastructure for software development workflows, including sandboxes, hosting, repositories, domains, package artifacts, and CI/CD-style automation. It offers these capabilities through a web platform plus programmatic interfaces for developers and AI agents.
summary: Buddy exposes three developer integration surfaces on buddy.works subdomains: a REST API at api.buddy.works, an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at mcp.buddy.works/mcp, and the bdy CLI; the API and MCP accept Buddy bearer tokens, and MCP also supports self-onboarding OAuth discovery/DCR.
